title: A question sent to both chat and page keeps the same option letters and labels in each, and a stored pick carries its label
why:
Owner 12:35 CST Nov 8, in the coordinator's chat: "just ensure that A and B mean the same on the artifact than what you send me otherwise we can reach a problem where the meaning changes from one to the other since they're static and not pointers". Item 436 was checked: chat and page a/b match. Fix: (1) when a question goes to both chat and page, the page item's options are copied from the chat question in the same order, and the chat question names the page item id; (2) a recorded pick stores the label with its letter (for example "b: Keep the rule; archive at merge"), never the letter alone; (3) a check refuses a page item whose label for a key differs from the chat question that cites it. Note: an item's `pick` field is the recommended option, not the answer; the answer lives in the answers collection. Item 436's pick "a" was triage's recommendation; the coordinator set it to b at 12:33 CST, which overwrites the recommendation record. 00:19 CST Nov 15: GitHub REST read: #2682 merged 2026-11-13T08:21:04Z (02:21 CST), 29 files. It delivers the original ask (guard rule option-labels-match-chat; a saved answer carries its label; `recommended` replaces `pick`). From its body, not read as landed: the 15:08 CST Nov 12 widening (a shown letter never changes; an answer to an item whose letters moved is held; chat copy and page item come from one source). The step stays doing for those parts only; done needs a read of what main holds for each. Incident 00:22 CST Nov 15 (repeat of the Nov 12 15:04 letter swap; owner's report, quoted from another repo's triage session, repo and item 251 not read by triage, unverified): owner 00:22 CST Nov 15: "ive raised this problem before btw but i guess its not been fixed yet, heres feedback from another repo’s triage session i just saw and notice whats worrisome about it that ive already flagged ‘Deviations * The coordinator wrote \"pick a\" for its fix, which is a bookmark plus 100 rows a page. In item 251 that is option b, since a is 100 rows only. I wrote this on the item and left the pick for you.’". The coordinator's pick sentence carried a letter that did not match its own label text, and the session handed the pick back to the owner instead of taking it. Parts 1 to 3 above (a shown letter never changes; an answer to an item whose letters moved is held; chat copy and page item from one source) are not read as built on main; the coordinator asked for a lane 00:26 CST Nov 15 (relayed by the consultant). Guard that would have stopped it: this step's parts 1 to 3, or a check that the letter in a pick sentence matches the option label text it names; queued as this step's parts, not built. Standing rule (consultant 00:26 CST Nov 15, its reading of the owner's 20:18 CST Nov 14 words "Nothing can't be undone don't wait on me"; ruling own-label-pick-taken-by-label): a pick whose label is plain is taken by its label, never handed back to the owner. Item 251 of the other repo takes b by its label (the consultant tells that repo's triage; triage reads no other repo).

Lane change 00:26 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 00:25 CST, relayed): new lane session_013NEJKzweba4vexkTs61zvR, "a pick's label decides; build the unbuilt parts of the step"; it read running and parented to the coordinator in list_sessions. Its old lane session_013NEJL45fP7ZgamcoEqWP6c is inactive (not in the session list; not read by get_session). Grant: the consultant's 00:26 relay of the owner's 00:22 words. 00:27 CST Nov 15: owner item 859 (ask-repo-of-item-251-note, saved 00:26 CST, a task item with a note box) asks which repo's triage wrote the item-251 note he pasted at 00:22 CST. This page's item 251 is mailaudit's write-budget record, not the "100 rows a page" note. The letters fix lane (session_013NEJKzweba4vexkTs61zvR) proceeds meanwhile.

11:45 CST Nov 15 (triage): owner answered page item 859 (ask-repo-of-item-251-note) done at 11:40:08 CST with the note "degen triage local" (verbatim): the item-251 "pick a vs b" note he pasted at 00:22 CST came from the Degen repo's triage, which runs locally. Fact, not a ruling. The consultant sends that repo's triage the line "item 251 takes b by its label"; this lane proceeds, nothing else waits.
note: Doing 05:58 CST Nov 10: open PR #2257 on branch option-keys-match-chat (triage live build). Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was coordinator ([ended:Claude-settings-coordinator-handoff]) to route). Lane prose-unmapped-3 started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium). PR #2682 handed to batch runner 10, lane lint PASS (lane fan-prose-unmapped-3 11:05 CST Nov 12). A stored pick carrying its label (this step, #2682) would have caught it. Scope widened 15:08 CST Nov 12 (retrospective, folding its option-letters-frozen ask; owner 15:04 CST: "the check swapped the letters -- holy fuck thats a huge problem LOL"): (1) once an option is shown to the owner, in chat or on the page, its letter never changes; a rule-driven change adds a note to that option and reorders nothing; (2) an answer to an item whose letters moved after it was shown is held, and the owner confirms in words; (3) the chat copy and the page item come from one source. Add to #2682 the parts it lacks, red first on item 646's 14:39 relabel. Ranked with the stability fixes.
